The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance…

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.
translations.bsb: Ephraim will have one portion bordering the territory of Manasseh from east to west.
translations.kjv: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.
translations.asv: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, Ephraim, one portion.
